placements.role: Executes large water tunnels and underground civil works.

role_evidence.claim: Afcons reported completing a breakthrough on an 8.7-kilometre treated-water tunnel using a TBM in December 2025.

business_summary: Afcons Infrastructure Limited is an Indian, NSE-listed (AFCONS.NS) heavy civil engineering contractor within the Shapoorji Pallonji group, executing large tunnels, marine works and underground infrastructure across India and select overseas markets. Its tunnelling and underground-works capability is the mapped exposure to the tibet-mega-dam chain's civil-construction link.

exposure_summary.narrative: Afcons sits on civil-construction, scored EMERGING. Its own December 2025 release documents an 8.7-kilometre treated-water tunnel breakthrough using tunnel boring machines, evidencing the large hard-rock tunnelling capability the link requires, but no project-specific revenue tied to Tibet-basin or downstream Brahmaputra works is sourced.
